name: Major cyber incidents
summary: CISA listed four more exploited flaws on 18 Nov, including LiteLLM and Synology DSM; no national-scale attack found
state: CISA added four actively exploited vulnerabilities on 18 Nov, in Synology DiskStation Manager, BerriAI LiteLLM, REDCap and Apache Axis, after a Check Point flaw on 13 Nov (CISA). Reports of gateways wiped through the Check Point flaw remain unconfirmed here. No national-scale attack on power, health or finance was found as of 19 Nov; Watch is kept on continued exploitation of widely used products, with risk easing.
for_you: Apply security updates for affected products promptly; the NCSC publishes guidance for organisations and individuals.
rubric_hit: Exploited flaws in widely used products (Check Point, Synology) = Watch; no national-scale attack
why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
